items.text: Seahawks placing first-round RB Jadarian Price on IR due to chest injury aggravated at practice; misses minimum four weeks. Signed Velus Jones Jr. from PS.
items.implication: Season-altering for Price; SEA backfield scramble.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Week 4 after hip/groin issue; returns from multi-game absence.
items.why: ETR comprehensive Sunday list; McVay expected play, no designation.
items.implication: WR1 return boosts Rams passing; Adams role may compress.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full snaps possible though limits speculated.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN for Week 4 after hamstring; returns from two-game absence.
items.why: ETR list; full practice progression, no designation.
items.implication: Elite WR1 back for Stroud; Texans offense upgrade.
Vikings WR corps depleted; heavy target redistribution.

items.text: Devonta Smith, Dallas Goedert listed OUT; Eagles also without Zack Baun.
items.why: ETR list; hamstring for Smith, confirmed.
items.implication: Eagles offense significantly worse vs Rams.

items.text: Colts WR Keenan Allen (groin) downgraded to OUT vs Commanders.
Great to have Puka Nacua (hip) back; speculation he could have snaps limited, we'll see.
items.why: Return from multi-week absence; hip/groin management.
items.implication: Monitor snap count early; still high-upside WR1 if unrestricted.
items.opportunity: Primary target share resumes vs Eagles sans key defenders.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return. DvP: Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans implied 7th-most points.
items.implication: Strong WR1 play; start with confidence.

items.text: The moment Jordan Addison truthers have been waiting for. Home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: JJ absence + home matchup vs soft secondary.
items.implication: WR2/3 with WR1 upside; clear alpha target.

items.text: Eagles situation getting worse. Will be without three of their most important players vs Rams: DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun.
items.implication: Lower team total/passing volume; Hurts less efficient.
items.opportunity: Wicks/Goedert handcuffs or other Eagles pass-catchers rise.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Emmanuel Wilson, pass work to Holani, back-to-back fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet (ACL) back at practice. Still passes eye test; far from over long-term. Projections updated.
items.implication: Short-term fade complete with IR; stash long-term.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): 90% snap rate last week, 20/22 RB touches; full workhorse with Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game.
LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share last week (9-194); NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 utilization, 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42%; SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
